title: Gambas Al Ajillo
notes: Arguably the most common and popular tapas dish in Spain you can't go wrong eating it with a glass of sherry or flute of cava. The garlic infuses into the oil with the zing of the chilli which makes it great to sop up with bread. This recipe can easily be multiplied to serve as a starter.

ingredientSections.heading: Gambas Al Ajillo
items: Olive Pomace Oil or Canola Oil
A good pinch of Chili Flakes

methodSections.heading: Gambas Al Ajillo
steps: Heat the oil that is about half a centimetre deep in a small fry pan.
When sizzling hot add the garlic, chillies, salt and sauté the prawns, flipping when the tail starts to turn pink. They won't need long.
When cooked finish with a splash dry fino sherry and flambe.
Garnish with micro greens or finely chopped
